description: This file declares the interface for the breakpad wrapper, providing function prototypes to add mapping info, handle exceptions, and auto-construct components related to crash handling or debugging.

methods.name: breakpad_AddMappingInfo
methods.description: Adds memory mapping information for breakpad symbolization, including name, identifier, address range, and file offset.

methods.name: breakpad_ExceptionHandler
methods.description: Sets up the breakpad exception handler.

methods.name: breakpad_autoconstruct
methods.description: Automatically constructs or initializes breakpad components.
